blendVariants.label: Maduro
blendVariants.title: Sun Grown Maduro Robusto
blendVariants.eyebrow: Broadleaf Maduro counterpart to Sun Grown
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Dark-roasted coffee, earth, cocoa, caramel, black licorice and pepper make the Sun Grown Maduro darker and sweeter than the standard Ecuadorian-Sumatra Sun Grown line. The oily Broadleaf wrapper sits over a Nicaraguan core, giving the Robusto dense body, roasted sweetness and a peppery finish without losing the line’s dry, earthy backbone.
blendVariants.noteHtml: Untasted. Catalogue pricing uses the currently available A$47.30 single rather than the A$906 box of 20 because single-cigars above A$30 are not benchmarked against bulk box/pack discounts.
